name: Cuff-slaved elbow: 4R path J1-A0-A1-J3 at the cap pole, elbow slaved by a crank to an arm-cuff pin (tether cell B)
family: virtual-joint 3R (4R path with a slaved elbow, one closed loop, pins only)
verdict: DEAD at gate 0 (converged): best honest 107.61 fast (score 60.87) vs the plain cap-pole 3R 63.18 through the same kit; frozen exact Bench(110,360) 117.08 (score 57.43) vs the control's 56.40. The lead's kill test fails on all three counts over 5729 kinematic layouts (ws closure max 0.789 < 0.80, dense follow max 0.833 < 0.95, every part <= 75 mm only at closure <= 0.68). Tether cell B best 132.86.
limiter: The slave loop's root vanishes along internally rotated climbs (Reach a high shelf 5/9 lost), cross-body (Wash opposite shoulder 7/9) and behind-back motions (dense K2) and on 53 ws poses; the 4R path's own window (elbow 2R open on 43-49 ws poses); the elbow parts (A0, A1, B0, crank A, link 1, coupler) 0-4 % in band at 97-137 mm because they roam the shoulder dome (O20 disc edges: the proxy's centre rays read 62-75). Overhead 5/28 frozen.
note: Honest kit (K3 march, K2 dense, K6, audit; q 1.0), Bench(60,160) fast; near-touch gap = plain gap at the best (min metal 1.54 mm). Sweep entries tagged v1 predate the layering fix. 0 passive translations, 3 passive pins, cx est. 15.5. mechanism.notes: 4R path J1-A0-A1-J3 with the elbow slaved by crank B from a third pin B0 on crank A to a pin B1 on the arm end. bodies: link 1, crank A (L-plate: A0, A1, B0), coupler (A1, J3), crank B, arm end (hub-3 lower plate + B1 tab + K7 neck). joints: J1, A0, J3 ACTIVE O20; A1, B0, B1 PASSIVE O20 pins; 1 loop (crank A - coupler - arm - crank B, a spherical four-bar in the arm frame; spherical Grubler 3 (6 - 1) - 2 x 6 = 3). Passives set by one loop root + the closed-form 2R: not sensed. custom: base, link 1, crank A, coupler, crank B, arm-end tab/neck, 6 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 6 x MR117 pair (est.).
